name: Spreading The Gospel
overview: Scripture commands believers to actively proclaim the gospel to all nations and peoples, declaring God's glory and wonders beyond cultural and geographic boundaries, as seen in Psalms 96:3 and Matthew 28:19. Jesus emphasizes that He is the exclusive way to the Father, underscoring the urgency and necessity of spreading this message (John 14:6). Empowered by the Holy Spirit, Christians are called to be witnesses from their local communities to the ends of the earth, fulfilling the mandate to preach the gospel universally before the end comes (Acts 1:8; Matthew 24:14; Mark 16:15).
